name: Enable HP Colors
help: Turn off healthbar customization and restore the game appearance.

name: Bar style
help: V1 is a plain rectangle. V2 uses the game's slanted bar shape. OLD splits the bar into 100-HP boxes like the 2024 healthbars.

name: Player bar colors
help: Enable custom player healthbar colors for this side.

name: Color mode
help: Fixed selects low, middle or high by health; gradient blends between them.

name: Low health color
help: Six-digit hex color at or below the low threshold.

name: Middle health color
help: Six-digit hex color at the high threshold in gradient mode.

name: High health color
help: Six-digit hex color at full health in gradient mode.

name: Team high color
help: Use Amber or Sapphire for high health when the team is known.

name: Low health threshold
help: Low color ends here; must stay below the high threshold.

name: High health threshold
help: Middle color ends here; must stay above the low threshold.

name: Amber color
help: Six-digit hex color for the Amber team. Team high color and the team HP number, stamina and name colors use it.

name: Sapphire color
help: Six-digit hex color for the Sapphire team. Team high color and the team HP number, stamina and name colors use it.

name: Damage shake
help: Shake the healthbar, HP number and name when the unit takes damage, like the game does. Buildings and objectives never shake.

name: Healing color
help: Color of the healing part of the bar while custom bar colors are on.

name: Damage delta color
help: Color of the recent-damage part of the bar while custom bar colors are on.

name: Bullet shield color
help: Color of the bullet shield part of the bar. The separate shield bar under it keeps the game look.

name: Rat King barrier color
help: Color of the Rat King barrier part of the bar while custom bar colors are on.

name: Shake strength
help: How far the bar tips while it shakes, in degrees. The game uses 3.

name: Show healthbar
help: Hide the healthbar itself. Health keeps updating and the HP number can stay visible.

name: Bar width
help: Healthbar width in pixels. The game bar is 79 pixels wide; the bar stays centered and health still reads correctly.

name: Bar height
help: Healthbar height in pixels. The game bar is 18 pixels tall; everything on the bar keeps its proportions.

name: Bar horizontal offset
help: Move the healthbar left or right, in pixels.

name: Bar vertical offset
help: Move the healthbar up or down, in pixels.

name: Show bar outline
help: Draw an outline around the healthbar.

name: Custom outline color
help: Use your own outline color instead of the game colors for enemies, allies, teams and low health.

name: Outline color
help: Six-digit outline color when custom outline color is enabled.

name: Outline thickness
help: Outline thickness in pixels at the default bar size.

name: Outline opacity
help: Opacity of the outline only.

name: Your health bar color
help: Colors your own health bar at the bottom of the screen. Off: plain white bar. Team: the color of the team you are on. Custom: the color below. Turn HP Colors off to get the game's colors back.

name: Your health bar custom color
help: Six-digit hex color for your own bottom health bar when its color is set to Custom.

name: Your shield bar
help: Merged: the game draws your shield inside your health bar and adds it to your HP number. Separate (old): the HUD from before the September 2026 update. Your shield gets its own green bar, the white bar shows only your health, and the number leaves the shield out. A Rat King barrier gets the old spirit-shield bar beside it, in the Rat King colour.

name: Custom HP number
help: Show the HP number beside the bar with your font, size, colors and position. Off puts it back where the game shows it, with the game look.

name: HP font
help: Font of the HP number.

name: HP font size
help: HP number size in pixels. It does not change with bar size.

name: HP color source
help: Color the HP number like the bar, with its own colors below, or all in the Amber or Sapphire team color. Team colors use the bar colors when the team is unknown.

name: HP custom color mode
help: Fixed or gradient colors for the HP number when it uses its own colors.

name: Low HP text color
help: Custom HP color at or below the shared low threshold.

name: Middle HP text color
help: Custom middle HP color at the shared high threshold.

name: High HP text color
help: Custom HP color at full health.

name: Team high color
help: With own colors, use the Amber or Sapphire team color instead of the high color when the team is known.

name: HP horizontal offset
help: Move the HP number left or right, in pixels at the default bar width. It moves further on wider bars and always stays near the bar.

name: HP vertical offset
help: Move the HP number up or down, in pixels at the default bar height. It moves further on taller bars and always stays near the bar.

name: HP outline strength
help: Thickness of the dark outline around the HP number. 5 keeps the game's own outline; 0 removes it.

name: HP alignment
help: Which way the HP number grows from its spot as it gets longer: left, both ways or right.

name: HP text tilt
help: Rotate the HP number in degrees. Positive values tilt it clockwise; 0 keeps it level.

name: Show hero name
help: Show or hide hero names. Shown names still fade in and out the way the game fades them.

name: Custom name color
help: Enable a custom hero-name color for this side.

name: Name color source
help: Use your name color, or the Amber or Sapphire team color. Without a known team the name color is used. Needs custom name color on.

name: Name color
help: Hero name color. While you spectate, names stay slightly see-through like in the game.

name: Name font size
help: Hero name font size in pixels.

name: Name horizontal offset
help: Move the hero name left or right, in pixels. It does not change with bar size and always stays near the bar.

name: Name vertical offset
help: Move the hero name up or down, in pixels. It does not change with bar size and always stays near the bar.

name: Name outline strength
help: Thickness of the dark outline around the hero name. 5 keeps the game's own outline; 0 removes it.

name: Name alignment
help: Which way the hero name grows from its spot above the bar: left, both ways or right.

name: Name tilt
help: Rotate hero names in degrees. Positive values tilt them clockwise; 0 keeps them level.

name: Lift name above OLD boxes
help: With bar style OLD, move hero names up one row for every 1,000 max HP so the boxes never cover them. Off keeps names in place.

name: Show health lines
help: Show the marks that divide each healthbar into health chunks.

name: Custom line color
help: Use your line color instead of the game colors. Spectator lines are unchanged.

name: Line color
help: Choose the color of the healthbar lines.

name: Line opacity
help: Make the healthbar lines more or less transparent.

name: Show kill marker
help: Show a kill-threshold marker on enemy healthbars while custom bar colors are on.

name: Kill marker color
help: Choose the enemy kill marker color.

name: Kill marker threshold
help: Place the marker at this health percentage. It stays visible even below that amount.

name: Kill marker width
help: Set the marker width. It is at least 1 pixel wide and stays inside the bar.

name: Custom stamina color
help: Choose a color for dash charges on this side. The game still controls how many are available. Team colors and low stamina need this on.

name: Stamina color source
help: Use your stamina color, or the Amber or Sapphire team color. Without a known team the stamina color is used. Needs custom stamina color on.

name: Stamina color
help: Choose the filled dash-charge and outline color. Empty charges stay black.

name: Low stamina threshold
help: At this many dash charges left or fewer, charges turn the low stamina color. 0 turns it off. Needs custom stamina color on.

name: Low stamina color
help: Color of the filled dash charges and their outline at or below the low stamina threshold.

name: Stamina shape
help: Show dash charges as arrows, circles or boxes. Default arrows, size, position and color restore the game look.

name: Stamina width
help: Adjust dash-charge width. The default 11 keeps the original width, including arrows.

name: Stamina height
help: Adjust dash-charge height. The default 4.48 keeps the original height, including arrows.

name: Stamina horizontal offset
help: Move dash charges left or right, separately from the healthbar.

name: Stamina vertical offset
help: Move dash charges up or down, separately from the healthbar.

name: Low HP pulse
help: Pulse the healthbar at low HP while custom bar colors are on. HP-number pulsing has its own toggle.

name: Pulse threshold
help: Start pulsing at or below this HP percentage. Shields do not count as HP.

name: Custom pulse color
help: Use your chosen color for the low-HP pulse.

name: Pulse color
help: Choose the low-HP pulse color.

name: Pulse HP number
help: Pulse the HP number at low health, even when custom bar colors are off.

name: Pulse HP size and position
help: Change enemy HP-number size and position at low health, separately from number pulsing.

name: Pulse HP size
help: Set the enemy HP-number font size while low-HP size and position changes are on.

name: Pulse HP horizontal offset
help: Move the enemy HP number left or right at low health. The offset scales with bar width and stays on screen.

name: Pulse HP vertical offset
help: Move the enemy HP number up or down at low health. The offset scales with bar height and stays on screen.

name: Pulse rate (BPM)
help: Set the pulse speed. Higher values pulse faster.

name: Pulse intensity
help: Choose 0 for subtle, 1 for medium or 2 for intense pulsing.

name: Pulse color mode
help: Fixed changes the bar and matching ultimate badge color. Gradient blends the pulse color over the filled bar.

name: Hide bar during pulse
help: Hide the enemy healthbar during a bar pulse, including the kill marker and ultimate background. The HP number can stay visible.

name: CRITICAL label
help: Allow the stock CRITICAL label on enemy and ally players. Off hides the label only; stock flashing remains.

name: ASSASSINATE label
help: Allow the stock ASSASSINATE label on enemy and ally players. Off hides the label only.

name: UNKILLABLE label
help: Allow the stock UNKILLABLE label on enemy and ally players. Off hides the label only; the stock HP-number treatment remains.

name: CRITICAL horizontal offset
help: Move CRITICAL left or right. It follows the bar.

name: CRITICAL vertical offset
help: Move CRITICAL up or down. It follows the bar.

name: ASSASSINATE horizontal offset
help: Move ASSASSINATE left or right. It follows the bar.

name: ASSASSINATE vertical offset
help: Move ASSASSINATE up or down. It follows the bar.

name: UNKILLABLE horizontal offset
help: Move UNKILLABLE left or right. It follows the bar.

name: UNKILLABLE vertical offset
help: Move UNKILLABLE up or down. It follows the bar.

name: Show enemy level badge
help: Show enemy hero levels with a colored rim that changes at power milestones.

name: Level horizontal offset
help: Move the level badge left or right. It follows the bar when anchoring is on.

name: Level vertical offset
help: Move the level badge up or down. It follows the bar when anchoring is on.

name: Anchor level and ultimate to bar
help: Keep level and ultimate badges attached when you move the bar. When off, their offsets scale with the bar instead.

name: Show ultimate progress
help: Show other heroes' ultimate cooldown progress on their world badges. Turning this off restores game badge and flame sizes.

name: Ultimate color mode
help: Use the bar color for the ultimate badge, or choose a separate color.

name: Ultimate custom color
help: Choose the ultimate badge color for Custom color mode.

name: Ultimate progress colors
help: Use the badge color, one cooldown color, or a gradient that changes as the ultimate recharges.

name: Ultimate unavailable color
help: Choose the color at the start of the ultimate cooldown.

name: Ultimate available color
help: Choose the color at the end of the ultimate cooldown.

name: Ultimate background darkness
help: Darken the unfilled part of the ultimate cooldown ring.

name: Ultimate horizontal offset
help: Move both enemy and ally ultimate badges left or right.

name: Ultimate vertical offset
help: Move both enemy and ally ultimate badges up or down.

name: Ultimate badge size
help: Set the ultimate badge and kill-streak flame size while ultimate progress is on. Turning progress off restores their game sizes.

name: Pickup styling and timers
help: Restyle the game's pickup icons above other heroes' bars and show pickup countdowns on the topbar.

name: Gun pickup color
help: Inner color of the gun pickup icon.

name: Movement pickup color
help: Inner color of the movement pickup icon.

name: Spirit pickup color
help: Inner color of the spirit pickup icon.

name: Survival pickup color
help: Inner color of the survival pickup icon.

name: Pickup symbol color
help: Color of the symbol inside each pickup icon.

name: Pickup ring darkness
help: Darkness of the empty part of the countdown ring. The inner color stays bright.

name: Pickup icon size
help: Set pickup icon width and height, separately from bar size.

name: Pickup spacing
help: Set the gap on each side of every pickup icon.

name: Pickup horizontal offset
help: Move pickup icons left or right.

name: Pickup vertical offset
help: Move pickup icons up or down.

name: Rejuvenator size
help: Set the rejuvenator icon size. The default is 24 pixels.

name: Rejuvenator horizontal offset
help: Move the rejuvenator icon left or right.

name: Rejuvenator vertical offset
help: Move the rejuvenator icon up or down.

name: Rejuvenator tilt
help: Rotate the rejuvenator icon. The default tilt is 6 degrees.

name: Customize NPC bars
help: Use this side's bar colors, size, position and HP-number settings for NPCs. Off leaves them uncustomized.

name: Customize objective bars
help: Use this side's bar colors, size, position and HP-number settings for buildings and objectives. Neutral objectives stay unchanged.

name: Customize neutral camps
help: Use the neutral fill color and enemy size, position and HP-number settings for neutral NPCs. Off leaves them uncustomized.

name: Neutral fill color
help: Choose a fixed healthbar color for neutral camps while their customization is on.
